name: Ticket
description: Primary entity capturing ticket details from submission through resolution, tracking complete lifecycle of support requests

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket

fields.name: ticketNumber
fields.description: Human-readable ticket number for reference

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the issue or request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the ticket (new, assigned, in_progress, resolved, closed, reopened)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the ticket (low, medium, high, urgent)

fields.name: category
fields.description: Category or type of the ticket (IT, payroll, benefits, etc.)

fields.name: submitterId
fields.description: ID of the user who submitted the ticket

fields.name: assignedAgentId
fields.description: ID of the agent assigned to handle the ticket

fields.name: assignedQueueId
fields.description: ID of the queue the ticket is assigned to

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the ticket was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the ticket

fields.name: resolvedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the ticket was resolved

fields.name: closedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the ticket was closed

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Expected resolution date based on priority and SLA

fields.name: resolutionNotes
fields.description: Notes describing how the ticket was resolved

fields.name: reopenCount
fields.description: Number of times the ticket has been reopened

fields.name: lastActivityAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the last activity on the ticket

name: User
description: Stores user information for all system participants including end users, support agents, and supervisors

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: passwordHash
fields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: User's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: User's last name

fields.name: role
fields.description: User's role in the system (end_user, support_agent, supervisor)

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department or organizational unit the user belongs to

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the user account is active

constraints.uniqueEmail: Email must be unique across all users
constraints.validRole: Role must be one of: end_user, support_agent, supervisor

name: Category
description: Lookup entity for ticket categorization including IT, HR, Facilities, and other department-specific categories used for routing and reporting

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the category

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the category (e.g., IT, HR, Facilities)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of what types of tickets belong to this category

fields.name: defaultQueueId
fields.description: ID of the default queue or team to route tickets in this category

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates whether this category is currently active and available for selection

fields.name: sortOrder
fields.description: Display order for sorting categories in lists and dropdowns

name: Priority
description: Lookup entity for ticket priority levels with associated SLA timeframes and escalation rules

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the priority level

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the priority level (e.g., Low, Medium, High, Critical)

fields.name: level
fields.description: Numeric level for priority ordering (1=lowest, 4=highest)

fields.name: slaResponseMinutes
fields.description: SLA timeframe in minutes for initial response

fields.name: slaResolutionMinutes
fields.description: SLA timeframe in minutes for ticket resolution

fields.name: color
fields.description: Hex color code for UI display (e.g., #FF0000 for Critical)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this priority level is currently active

fields.name: sortOrder
fields.description: Display order in dropdown lists and UI

name: Status
description: Lookup entity for ticket statuses with workflow state transition rules

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the status

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the status (e.g., New, Assigned, In Progress, Pending, Resolved, Closed)

fields.name: statusType
fields.description: Category of status: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING, RESOLVED, CLOSED

fields.name: isTerminal
fields.description: Indicates if this is a final state (no further transitions allowed)

fields.name: allowedTransitions
fields.description: Array of status IDs that this status can transition to

fields.name: color
fields.description: Hex color code for UI display (e.g., #FF5733)

fields.name: sortOrder
fields.description: Display order in lists and dropdowns

name: Queue
description: Entity defining support queues for ticket routing and assignment to agent groups

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the queue

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the queue

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the queue purpose and scope

fields.name: categoryId
fields.description: Reference to the category this queue handles

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the queue is currently active and accepting tickets

fields.name: maxCapacity
fields.description: Maximum number of tickets that can be assigned to this queue

fields.name: currentLoad
fields.description: Current number of active tickets in the queue

relationships.description: Queue belongs to a specific category

constraints.maxCapacity: Must be a positive integer or null
constraints.name: Must be unique within the system

name: Comment
description: Stores ticket comments, notes, and communication between users and agents with full audit trail

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the comment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parent ticket

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who created the comment

fields.name: commentText
fields.description: The actual comment or note content

fields.name: isInternal
fields.description: Flag indicating if comment is internal (visible only to agents) or public

fields.name: commentType
fields.description: Type of comment: note, status_update, resolution, or reply

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when comment was created

relationships.description: Each comment belongs to one ticket
Each comment is created by one user

indexes.name: idx_comment_ticket
indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments by ticket in chronological order

indexes.name: idx_comment_user
indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments by user

commentType.description: Restrict comment types to predefined values

name: Attachment
description: Stores file attachments related to tickets including documents, screenshots, and supporting materials with metadata and storage locations

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the attachment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket this attachment belongs to

fields.name: uploadedByUserId
fields.description: Reference to the user who uploaded the attachment

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: Original name of the uploaded file

fields.name: fileSize
fields.description: Size of the file in bytes

fields.name: fileType
fields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., image/png, application/pdf)

fields.name: storagePath
fields.description: Path or URL where the file is stored in the storage system

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded

relationships.description: Each attachment belongs to one ticket
Each attachment is uploaded by one user

indexes.name: idx_attachment_ticket
indexes.description: Index for efficient retrieval of attachments by ticket

indexes.name: idx_attachment_uploaded_at
indexes.description: Index for sorting attachments by upload date

constraints.allowedFileTypes: Whitelist of permitted file types for security

name: QueueMember
description: Junction entity linking agents to queues they can work from, managing queue membership and agent availability

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the queue membership

fields.name: queueId
fields.description: Reference to the queue this membership belongs to

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user (agent) assigned to the queue

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the agent is currently active and available in this queue

fields.name: addedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the agent was added to the queue

fields.name: addedBy
fields.description: Reference to the user who added this agent to the queue

relationships.description: User who created this queue membership

indexes.description: Ensures an agent can only be added once to a queue
Optimizes queries for active agents in a queue
Optimizes queries for all queues an agent belongs to

constraints.uniqueQueueMembership: A user can only have one membership record per queue
constraints.validReferences: queueId must reference existing Queue, userId and addedBy must reference existing User

name: TicketHistory
description: Audit entity tracking all changes to tickets including status changes, assignments, priority updates, and field modifications for compliance and reporting

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket that was modified

fields.name: changedByUserId
fields.description: Reference to the user who made the change

fields.name: changeType
fields.description: Type of change (status_change, assignment, priority_update, field_modification, etc.)

fields.name: fieldName
fields.description: Name of the field that was changed

fields.name: oldValue
fields.description: Previous value before the change

fields.name: newValue
fields.description: New value after the change

fields.name: changedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the change occurred

relationships.description: Each history record belongs to one ticket
Each history record is created by one user

indexes.name: idx_ticket_history_ticket_id
indexes.description: Index for efficient retrieval of all changes for a specific ticket

indexes.name: idx_ticket_history_changed_at
indexes.description: Index for time-based queries and reporting

indexes.name: idx_ticket_history_change_type
indexes.description: Index for filtering by type of change

name: SLATracking
description: Tracks SLA compliance metrics for tickets including response and resolution deadlines, breach status, and escalation levels

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the SLA tracking record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket being tracked

fields.name: priorityId
fields.description: Reference to the priority level that determines SLA thresholds

fields.name: responseDeadline
fields.description: Deadline by which the first response must be provided

fields.name: resolutionDeadline
fields.description: Deadline by which the ticket must be resolved

fields.name: firstResponseAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the first response was provided to the ticket

fields.name: responseBreached
fields.description: Indicates if the response SLA deadline was breached

fields.name: resolutionBreached
fields.description: Indicates if the resolution SLA deadline was breached

fields.name: escalationLevel
fields.description: Current escalation level (0=none, 1=first level, 2=second level, etc.)

relationships.description: Each SLA tracking record belongs to one ticket
Each SLA tracking record is associated with a priority level

constraints.uniqueTicket: Each ticket can have only one SLA tracking record
constraints.deadlineOrder: Resolution deadline must be after response deadline
constraints.escalationRange: Escalation level must be a non-negative integer

name: Notification
description: Tracks email notifications sent to users for ticket updates, assignments, resolutions, and SLA alerts

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket this notification relates to

fields.name: recipientUserId
fields.description: Reference to the user receiving the notification

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification (e.g., ticket_created, ticket_assigned, ticket_updated, ticket_resolved, sla_warning, sla_breach)

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Email subject line for the notification

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was sent

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Status of notification delivery (e.g., sent, delivered, failed, bounced)

relationships.description: Each notification is associated with one ticket
Each notification is sent to one user
